The sun dipped beneath the horizon, painting the sky with hues of orange and purple. The town of Eldenwood, nestled in the arms of the ancient forest, was now enveloped in the soft glow of twilight.

The streets were empty save for the occasional flicker of a street lamp. The trees around Eldenwood seemed to whisper secrets of the forest, their leaves rustling with the secrets of the ages.
